create_ValidationResult: create a ValidationResult instance with a compiler environment state and walltime
check_ValidationResult_okay: check whether a ValidationResult passed validation using the okay method
get_ValidationResult_error_details: get a formatted summary of validation errors from a ValidationResult using error_details
join_ValidationResult: join multiple ValidationResult instances into a single union result using the join class method
compare_ValidationResult: compare two ValidationResult instances for equality ignoring walltime and error order
